facts.en: Completed a library support diploma at Fictional Quillmeadow College in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构羽草学院完成图书馆支持文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid shelving assistant at Fictional Alderbook Branch Library from 2020-09 to 2023-02.
facts.zh: 2020-09 至 2023-02 在虚构桤书分馆任有薪排架助理。

facts.en: At the branch, reshelved returned books by catalogue code and checked reservation slips against item barcodes.
facts.zh: 在分馆按目录代码将归还图书重新排架，并依据图书条码核对预约凭条。

facts.en: Paid outreach assistant with Fictional Lanternpage Mobile Library from 2023-03 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-03 至 2026-08 在虚构灯页流动图书馆任有薪外展助理。

facts.en: Prepared rotating book crates from the librarian’s approved stop-specific stock lists.
facts.zh: 依据图书馆员批准的各停靠点专用藏书清单，准备轮换图书箱。

facts.en: Scanned loans and returns while the vehicle was parked and recorded items requiring catalogue correction.
facts.zh: 在车辆停稳时扫描借出及归还图书，并记录需要目录更正的图书。

facts.en: Helped visitors locate reserved books and referred account restrictions to the outreach librarian.
facts.zh: 协助访客查找预约图书，并将账户限制问题转交外展图书馆员。

facts.en: The assigned driver drove and parked the mobile library; the candidate’s duties were bookstock and visitor support.
facts.zh: 指定司机驾驶并停放流动图书馆车辆；候选人职责为藏书及访客支持。

facts.en: Helped refresh a picture-book activity kit in 2025-02 for use at community stops.
facts.zh: 2025-02 协助更新供社区停靠点使用的绘本活动套件。

facts.en: Personally prepared 18 reusable picture cards and a packing checklist from the librarian’s activity plan.
facts.zh: 个人依据图书馆员活动方案准备 18 张可重复使用图片卡及打包核对表。

facts.en: Set out the activity kit and helped children find matching cards during librarian-led sessions.
facts.zh: 在图书馆员主持的活动中摆放活动套件，并协助儿童寻找匹配图片卡。

facts.en: Recorded session dates and group attendance counts on the librarian’s reporting sheet.
facts.zh: 在图书馆员报告表上记录活动日期及团体出席人数。

facts.en: Those attendance sheets did not record individual reading levels or follow-up learning assessments.
facts.zh: 这些出席表未记录个人阅读水平或后续学习评估。

facts.en: Uses circulation scanners, catalogue searches, crate checklists and a shared outreach calendar.
facts.zh: 使用借还扫描器、目录检索、图书箱核对表及共享外展日历。

facts.en: Checked returned activity materials against the kit list and noted items needing replacement.
facts.zh: 依据套件清单核对归还活动材料，并注明需要更换的物品。

facts.en: Completed internal visitor-support and safeguarding-reporting induction in 2023-03.
facts.zh: 2023-03 完成内部访客支持及人员保护（safeguarding）问题上报入职培训。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Storyfern Weekend Club from 2018-10 to 2019-06, preparing name badges and setting out board games.
facts.zh: 2018-10 至 2019-06 在虚构故事蕨周末社做志愿者，准备姓名牌并摆放桌游。

facts.en: For that club, co-created a noncommercial treasure-hunt story with another volunteer; personally drew the clue pictures.
facts.zh: 为该社与另一名志愿者共同创作非商业寻宝故事；个人绘制线索图片。

facts.en: Keeps a personal notebook of fictional animal stories written for enjoyment, not commissioned educational materials.
facts.zh: 保留个人虚构动物故事笔记，写作为消遣，而非受委托教育材料。

facts.en: Enjoys making fabric book sleeves from spare cloth.
facts.zh: 爱好用剩余布料制作布艺书套。

facts.en: Prepared end-of-route handovers listing unfilled reservations, catalogue questions and incomplete activity kits.
facts.zh: 在路线结束时准备交接，列明未满足预约、目录问题及不完整活动套件。
